question: What does Isaiah say will happen to the mountain of the LORD's temple in the last days?
options: It will be covered by the sea
It will be moved to another land
It will be established as the highest of the mountains
It will be hidden from all nations
explanation: Isaiah 2:2 says that in the last days the mountain of the LORD's temple will be established as the highest of the mountains, and all nations will stream to it.
